title: Cebiche, chifa and nikkei: how Peru eats
goal: Describe Peruvian food and its immigrant roots, choosing between the passive se and the impersonal se.
grammar: distinguishing the passive se from impersonal se constructions

items: I can choose between passive and impersonal *se* (*se sirven los cebiches*, *se invitó a los vecinos*).
I can say what cebiche, chifa and nikkei cooking are and where they come from.
I can use the new words for food: *cebiche*, *ají*, *camote*, *inmigrante*.
